shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc 'git status --short && cat package.json && cat app/page.tsx && cat app/product/page.tsx && cat app/layout.tsx && cat next.config.ts'
/bin/bash -lc 'for p in /AGENTS.md /workspace/AGENTS.md; do if [ -f "$p" ]; then cat "$p"; fi; done'
/bin/bash -lc 'cat lib/data.ts && cat tsconfig.json && git diff -- package.json && test -d node_modules && node --version && npm --version'

[\\s\\S]*?<\\/main>/)?.[0]; assert.ok(main, \"Product shell contains main content\"); assert.ok(main.includes(\"

/bin/bash -lc "git show HEAD:tsconfig.json > tsconfig.json
node --input-type=module -e 'import { rmSync } from \"node:fs\"; rmSync(\".next\", { recursive: true, force: true }); rmSync(\"next-env.d.ts\", { force: true });'
